description: This file contains the server-side code for the ExamResult page in an online examination system. It handles loading the exam results, updating user statistics in the database, and setting UI elements with session data.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Partial class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, handling page load events and button actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load, retrieves session data, updates user info in the database, and populates UI elements.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the LoginPage, effectively logging out the user.
